svg.title: A Footprints run in a terminal: an agent script edits config.toml and creates NOTES.md, then log, diff and undo
svg.desc:
$ cat agent.sh sed 's/auto_save = false/auto_save = true/' config.toml > config.toml.new mv config.toml.new config.toml printf '# Notes

Saving is now automatic.
' > NOTES.md $ footprints run --agent demo -- sh agent.sh footprints: recorded command #1 in session run-cfba72f4 with 2 file change(s). See `footprints log --session run-cfba72f4` $ footprints log ID TIME AGENT SESSION KIND STATE TARGET 1 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 command not reversible sh agent.sh 2 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 file_create reversible NOTES.md (via #1) 3 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 file_write reversible config.toml (via #1) $ footprints diff 3 --- a/home/me/demo/config.toml +++ b/home/me/demo/config.toml @@ -1,3 +1,3 @@ theme = "light" font_size = 14 -auto_save = false +auto_save = true $ footprints undo 3 undid #3: restored /home/me/demo/config.toml (recorded as #4 in session undo-cce3d2c9) $ footprints log ID TIME AGENT SESSION KIND STATE TARGET 1 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 command not reversible sh agent.sh 2 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 file_create reversible NOTES.md (via #1) 3 2026-11-05 16:15:04 demo run-cfba72f4 file_write undone config.toml (via #1) 4 2026-11-05 16:15:04 footprints undo-cce3d2c9 file_write reversible config.toml (undo of #3)
